title: DecisionRecord
description: Canonical Reclose protocol semantic decision record, corrected per external A0 review findings A0-003 and A0-R3. GenLayer determines the judgment; this record contains semantic codes only, never arbitrary calldata/target/authority payloads (CLAUDE.md Section 6, TM-AUTH-003). This record is bound to the target/policy/rule/evidence it decided over (MDP/ADR-011 evidence binding) and MUST NOT embed GenLayer transaction lifecycle state - lifecycle belongs only to a separate product-facing composition (see DecisionView.schema.json). Mixing lifecycle into this record was the defect identified in A0-003 and has been removed. `reporter` is a required canonical field per Master Design Package Section 21's DecisionRecord field list, which names it as a plain field with no null/optional annotation and no documented system-initiated exception - see A0-R3.

schemaVersion.description: DecisionRecord schema version, independent of the Frontend Contract freeze version.

decisionId.description: Optional internal indexing identity. Never used as a replacement for incidentId/ruleId/decisionStage identity - purely a lookup convenience.

policyHash.description: Canonical hash of the active policy at decision time (RFC 8785 JCS + Keccak, ADR-010; TM-AUTH-011).

ruleId.description: The governed R1 Judge rule family that produced this decision (CLAUDE.md Section 14). Reporter cannot supply an arbitrary rule (TM-EVID-002).

affectedResource.description: The protected resource/capability the rule and effect are scoped to (ADR-013 target defense in depth).

evidenceHash.description: Canonical hash of the Evidence Artifact Package this decision was evaluated against (TM-EVID-013 binding).

reporter.description: Reporter address (required canonical field per Master Design Package Section 21). Every governed R1 rule family, including RECOVERY_VALIDATED_V1, is submitted by an identified Reporter address (which MAY be the target owner/operator acting as their own Reporter for a remediation/recovery submission) - there is no locked governance decision authorizing a reporter-less DecisionRecord, so this field is never null (A0-R3).

outcome.description: Canonical DecisionRecord.outcome per A0-T3: NONE is a storage/internal uninitialized value only (see DecisionOutcome.schema.json) and MUST NOT appear in an emitted canonical DecisionRecord - every emitted decision is a completed judgment.

conditionCode.description: Rule-specific semantic condition code produced by the Judge (e.g. the specific sub-condition of PROVIDER_COMPROMISE_V1 that was found true/false). Distinct from `outcome`: `outcome` is the Reclose-wide CONFIRMED/REJECTED/UNDETERMINED classification; `conditionCode` is the rule's own finer-grained semantic result. Never an executable instruction or arbitrary payload (TM-AUTH-003).

reasonCodes.description: Reason-indexed codes used to drive restriction composition (CLAUDE.md Section 17; TM-REC-001/008). May be empty for a decision that does not create or resolve a restriction.

judgeModule.description: Address/identity of the Judge module that produced this decision (AS-04; TM-AUTH-008).

decisionStage.description: Canonical DecisionRecord.decisionStage per A0-T3: NONE is a storage/internal uninitialized value only (see DecisionStage.schema.json) and MUST NOT appear in an emitted canonical DecisionRecord.

generatedAt.description: When this DecisionRecord was generated by the Judge/Kernel. Distinct from GenLayer transaction lifecycle timing, which lives only in DecisionView.
